welcome_lead: Strong passwords and smart habits are the locks on your digital door.

final_note: Most attacks fail against people who know what to look.

walkthroughs.body_html: Long is stronger than complex. Use a phrase like orange-lamp-river-42. Never reuse passwords. A password manager remembers them for you.
Phishing messages create panic and ask you to click a link or share a code. Pause, check the sender address and go to the real site directly.
No single defence is perfect. Stack two-factor, updates, antivirus and good habits. Attackers move on when one layer slows them down.
